blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace Press Officer Claire Castro on Thursday bristled at accusations that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was making Filipinos suffer for his supposed “vanity,” as the president hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. During a briefing, Castro took issue with a statement from Bagong Alyansang Makabayan President Renato Reyes Jr. Reyes earlier questioned how the government could solve the country’s problems if it refused to acknowledge them and, worse, covered them up.
